name: Blaze Internet Services
summary: Ipswich/Brisbane dialup + hosting ISP, part of the aunz.com regional network (same plans as Australis); dead.

events.details: Listed in the Cynosure ISP directory (Oct 2001) as Blaze, Silkstone (Ipswich) QLD 4304 on the aunz.com network; no independent web captures of blaze.aunz.com survive.
Alive in the Cynosure ISP directory Oct 2001; blaze.aunz.com is not archived, so the exact end date is unknown.
